description: This file contains a function 'maybeRepairUiProtocolFreshness' that manages the validation and rebuilding of UI assets based on schema and UI index file timestamps, including interactions with the filesystem, version control, and user prompts.

methods.name: maybeRepairUiProtocolFreshness
methods.description: Asynchronously checks the freshness of UI assets against the protocol schema and rebuilds the UI if necessary, involving user prompts and filesystem operations.
